parsed.post: Discarding the 1.056 run as it regressed from my best 1.051. The high batch size (524k) likely reduces the total number of optimizer steps possible within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 131072 and increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to balance stability and training throughput.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 131072 and increasing warmup to 0.1 to increase step count and improve stability.
